groups.name: usb
groups.why: USB-C receptacle (declared pose, west edge) with its CC 5k1 pull-downs R52/R53, the shield RC R3/C13, the VBUS ferrite FB1 into /VUSB, U15 TPD3S014 (VBUS current-limit switch + D+/D- ESD: VUSB in, +5V out) with its input cap C8, and the USB/VBUS test points on the back

groups.name: power
groups.why: the two board LDOs from +5V: U8 TLV75533 (+3V3) and U36 TLV73312 (+1V2), their input caps C26/C86 (4u7 +5V), the 150u bulk C87 on +5V, and their front-face output caps C28 (4u7 +3V3) and C27 (4u7 +1V2); the rail test points. Not sent to an edge: by its entry, between USB and the loads

groups.name: reset
groups.why: the reset button SW1 (side-actuated TC-1109DE, so it belongs on an edge) with the APX811 supervisor U7 (its ~MR cap C89; ~RESET drives U8 EN), the diode-OR D24 into the FX2 ~RESET, the FX2 reset RC R4/R5/C88; C16 (u1 +5V) is the supervisor U7 VCC decap

groups.name: fx2
groups.why: the CY7C68013A USB controller U1 with its 24 MHz crystal Y1 and load caps C11/C12, its +3V3 decaps C2-C7/C9/C10 (back face, one per supply pin) and bulk C19 plus the declared 4u7 C1, the ENVA/ENVB pull-downs R18/R19 at PD0/PD6, the FPGA ~CRESET pull-down R9 and ~ALERT pull-up R17 on its PA pins, and the CLKREF/CLKIF test points

groups.name: fpga
groups.why: the iCE40HX8K BGA-121 U30 (the main IC: central), its VCCIO/VPP/VCC_SPI +3V3 decaps C20/C21/C23/C81, its +1V2 core decaps C18/C24/C25/C77 and 4u7 C14 (back face, under the ball field), the two PLL filters R31+C76/C78 and R32+C79/C80, and the VCCIO_3 (VIO_AUX) decaps C33/C92

groups.name: leds
groups.why: the status LEDs: D1 power (R12 from +3V3), D2-D5 driven by the FX2 (R13-R16), D6-D10 the FPGA user LEDs (R11, R20-R23); each LED with its resistor, as one row along an edge

groups.name: sync_aux
groups.why: the SYNC KK connector J4 (declared pose) with its ESD D11, pull-up R44, the SN74LVC1T45 buffer U32 (series R38/R45, DIR pull-down R10, decap C85), and the AUX header J10 with its ESD diodes D12/D13 and 47R series R39/R43 to the FPGA

groups.name: eeprom
groups.why: the two I2C EEPROMs U2/U3 and their decaps C15/C17 (all declared poses), the DNP address strap R40, and the I2C bus pull-ups R1/R2 with the SDA/SCL test points: the pull-ups at a peripheral end of the bus

groups.name: bankA_io
groups.why: I/O bank A: the IDC header J2 (declared pose) with its ESD arrays D22/D23, the eight SN74LVC1T45 level shifters U4..U18 between the FPGA-side 33R arrays RN7/RN8 and the port-side 33R arrays RN9/RN10, the 10k pull arrays RN11/RN12 driven by the PCA6408 expander U19 (reset pull-up R37), the DNP sockets J8/J9, and the shifters' +3V3 (VCCA) and VIOA (VCCB) decaps

groups.name: bankA_pwr
groups.why: bank A's I/O supply: the adjustable LDO U31 from +5V (input caps C82/C59, enable R55 and the ALERT diode D19), its feedback divider R33/R34/R35 set by the DAC U20, the 0R33/0R15 sense chain R56/R8/R49/R51 measured by the INA233 U21 (input filter R30/R54/C58, Vbus filter R60/C91 from VSENSE with its TVS D17), the VIOA bulk C83 and bleed R42/R58, U20/U21 decaps C55/C56, the ENVA indicator D15/R47 and the VDAC test point

groups.name: bankB_io
groups.why: I/O bank B, the same circuit as bank A: IDC header J3 (declared pose), ESD D20/D21, level shifters U22..U29, 33R arrays RN1-RN4, 10k pull arrays RN5/RN6 with the PCA6408 U5 (R36), DNP sockets J6/J7, and the shifters' +3V3 and VIOB decaps

groups.name: bankB_pwr
groups.why: bank B's I/O supply, as bank A's: LDO U14 (C31/C45 in, R26 enable, D18), divider R27/R28/R29 with DAC U13, sense chain R7/R6/R48/R50 and INA233 U12 (R24/R25/C44, R59/C90, TVS D16), VIOB bulk C53 and bleed R41/R57, U12/U13 decaps C22/C30, the ENVB indicator D14/R46 and the VDAC test point
